name: IP Address Classifier
description: Classify an IPv4 or IPv6 address as private, public/global, loopback, link-local, multicast, documentation or another recognized special-use category.
search_intent: Determine what type of IPv4 or IPv6 address an IP address is.
calculation: Parse the IP address without DNS or network requests. Match it against an explicitly maintained set of recognized IPv4 and IPv6 special-purpose ranges. Report the most specific applicable classification and range. Do not determine public reachability by making an external connection.
limitations: Classification is based on address ranges, not actual network reachability.
Special-purpose allocations can evolve and should be documented from authoritative standards.
A syntactically global address is not proof that a device is reachable from the public Internet.
